description: Governed closed lists introduced by the procedure facet (procedural / SOP source). Mirrors the governance pattern of intent.enum.json. These are the vocabularies the authoring/headwater agent must draw from; the validator rejects anything else.

governance.rule: Atoms and procedure bindings may only use ids defined here. New values require a version bump and an entry.
governance.scope: meaning.kind (procedural values only — the field is otherwise open/example-tagged) and bindings.procedure.step_type (fully closed).

meaning_kind.description: Additive GOVERNED values for atom.meaning.kind that mark procedural content. The field stays open for other content kinds; these two are closed for procedures.

values.label: Procedure
values.definition: A controlled procedural container (an SOP or sub-procedure). Its meaning is the procedure's title/purpose; its steps are child atoms via object.belongs_to.

values.label: Procedure Step
values.definition: A single leaf step within a procedure. Its meaning is the action instruction; execution semantics live in the procedure binding.

step_type.description: The kind of procedural move a step makes. Fully closed. Canonical source for the enum mirrored in procedure.facet.schema.json.

values.label: Action
values.definition: Perform a task. May produce records (produces_records).

values.label: Decision
values.definition: A branch point. Routes to other steps via branches[]; the human-readable condition is the step's own meaning.

values.label: Verification
values.definition: A QC / acceptance check. Points at an acceptance-criterion atom via acceptance_ref.
